content.title: Stratasys completes US rollout of 3D-printed imaging support material

content.title: SSYS Q3 Deep Dive: Margin Initiatives and End-Market Focus Amid Capital Equipment Pressure
content.summary: 3D printing company Stratasys (NASDAQ:SSYS) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 2.2% year on year to $137 million. The company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $555 million at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.02 per share was $0.02 above analysts’ consensus estimates.
